theater: 克里米亞北岸迦勒迦河下游

battle.name: 迦勒迦河之戰
battle.theater: 克里米亞北岸迦勒迦河下游
battle.brief: 1223年5月31日，蒙古軍與羅斯諸公國聯軍在克里米亞北岸迦勒迦河下游相遇。哲別前鋒渡河佯敗，聯軍分三處渡河追擊，輜重車隊留在河的另一側，終遭速不台主力自高處俯衝合圍，全軍覆沒，公侯被俘。此役屬騎兵野戰，配重投石車並未上陣，但它代表的攻城技術已同時存在於羅斯與金帳汗國的工匠營。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 迦勒迦河之戰的交戰雙方，是金帳汗國（拔都的西部兀魯思）與羅斯諸公國聯軍。蒙古一方由哲別率前鋒列，與速不台所統主力會合，騎兵是絕對主體，並有阿蘭人、華裔的隨軍工匠、攻城匠，以及黑海沿岸的希臘與阿蘭向导隨行；指揮體系沿用草原式的十進編制，軍令以火煙、鼓號與傳騎傳遞，後方由薩萊與汗國的作坊供應弓矢、鎧甲與繩索，攻城器械則多由工匠營就地打造。羅斯一方並非單一國家，而是以加利奇－沃里尼亞王國為核心，加上基輔公國、切爾尼戈夫公國、諾沃哥羅德－謝韋爾斯克公國等諸王公組成的聯軍，並有庫曼人（波洛伏齊人）部眾隨行；作戰單位仍是十一世紀以來的老式十進體制：親王的德魯日納侍從團、世襲波亞爾騎士，以及按百人與千人編成的斯梅爾德民眾兵。聯軍由加利奇王穆斯特拉夫·雷斯坦諾維奇與基輔王穆斯特拉夫·米斯提斯拉維奇共同統率，後方還拖著從頓河與庫班草原劫掠回來的戰利品車隊與畜群，那支車隊是全軍最慢的一環。
countriesEn: The two sides in the Battle of the Kalka were the Golden Horde, the western ulus of Batu, and a coalition of the Rus' principalities. On the Mongol side, Noyan Jebe led the forward detachment and Noyan Subutai the main body; cavalry was overwhelmingly the arm, and the train carried Alans, Chinese auxiliaries, engineers and siege craftsmen, together with Greek and Alan guides from the Black Sea littoral. Command followed the steppe decimal organisation of the khanate, orders travelling by smoke, drums and mounted messengers, while the workshops of the Horde at Sarai supplied bows, arrows, armour and rope and siege engines were generally built on the spot by the engineer corps. The Rus' side was not a single state but a coalition built around the principality of Galicia-Volhynia together with Kiev, Chernigov, Novgorod-Seversk and other princely polities, with Cuman, that is Polovtsian, contingents riding alongside. Their tactical organisation was still the old tenth-century decimal one: the prince's druzhina, the hereditary boyar cavalry, and the smerd levies enrolled in hundreds and thousands. The coalition was jointly led by Mstislav Rostislavich of Halych and Mstislav Mstislavich of Kiev, and behind it dragged a train of booty and herds taken in the Don and Kuban steppes, the slowest element of the whole army.
people: 蒙古方面的關鍵人物是哲別與速不台。哲別是長子术赤的部將，蒙古語的意思是神箭手，他曾參與追滅花剌子模的西征；1222至1223年間，他與速不台率一萬騎越過高加索，掃蕩格魯吉亞、亞美尼亞與亞塞拜疆，又深入波斯哈里發轄下的諸城，繞黑海北岸一直掃到波羅的海沿岸，1223年春天才折返東南，恰好撞上羅斯聯軍。速不台則率大隊主力北行，於戰役當日居高臨下衝下台地完成合圍。拔都本人並不在此戰現場，他仍在蒙古本部西征的前線，此役是兀魯思西部邊境的一次遭遇性行動。羅斯方面的核心是穆斯特拉夫·雷斯坦諾維奇，即後人稱為勇敢的穆斯特拉夫者，沃里尼亞與加利奇的實際君主；1221年與1222年他兩度率軍深入草原打擊庫曼人與波洛伏齊人，正是這批掠奪性戰役把聯軍的士氣與財物推到最高，也把蒙古人的行軍方向引到家門口。1223年5月出發時他自任前鋒，率自己約六千人的親兵率先渡河反擊，是全場最勇猛也最衝動的一手。基輔王穆斯特拉夫·米斯提斯拉維奇與切爾尼戈夫王羅曼·伊戈列維奇帶本部兵馬與強壯侍從趕到，負責中軍與指揮；羅曼之子奧列格與加利奇王丹尼爾也在陣中，是最後僅有的逃出包圍的統帥。丹尼爾的母親是匈牙利公主安娜，其姐索菲婭嫁給匈牙利王子科洛曼，這層關係在1223年毫無作用，卻在1239年救了他們全家的性命。編年史另記載蒙古人殺死了跟隨羅斯軍隊的希臘商人與阿蘭向导，使開戰前的談判管道斷裂。
peopleEn: The decisive figures on the Mongol side were Jebe and Subutai. Jebe was a commander in the host of Jochi's eldest son Tochi; his name means archer in Mongolian, and he had taken part in the western campaign that destroyed the Khwarazmian empire. Between 1222 and 1223 he and Subutai rode with about ten thousand men across the Caucasus, through Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, plundered the cities of the Abbasid caliph's dominions in Persia, swept the northern shore of the Black Sea as far as the Baltic and turned back in the spring of 1223, which is exactly when they ran into the Rus' coalition. Subutai commanded the main body, moving north and coming down from the heights on the day of the battle to close the trap. Batu himself was not present; he was still with the central Mongol armies in the west, and the Kalka was an incidental action on the western frontier of the ulus. At the Rus' end the central figure was Mstislav Rostislavich, later called Mstislav the Bold, effective ruler of Volhynia and Halych, who in 1221 and 1222 twice rode deep into the steppe against the Cumans and Polovtsians; those plunder campaigns raised the coalition's morale and wealth to their peak and simultaneously dragged the Mongol movement into his own doorstep. When the army set out in May 1223 he took the vanguard himself, leading roughly six thousand of his own men across the river in the first attack, the bravest and most impetuous move of the day. Mstislav Mstislavich of Kiev and Roman Igorevich of Chernigov arrived with their own levies and their stronger retinues, holding the centre and the command; Roman's son Oleg and Daniel of Halych were also present and were the only commanders to escape the encirclement. Daniel's mother was the Hungarian princess Anna of Csilla and his sister Sophia had married the Hungarian prince Coloman; that connection was of no help in 1223, yet in 1239 it saved the whole family's lives. The chronicle also records that the Mongols killed the Greek merchants and Alan guides travelling with the Rus' army, which cut off any channel of negotiation before the fighting began.
kits: 卡片上這件配重投石車，在1223年的歐亞軍事體系中屬於剛站穩腳跟的新技術。它以長臂末端的配重箱提供動力，把石彈拋過城牆，作為對固定堡壘的攻城主力；但在迦勒迦河這樣的野戰中，它沒有、也不可能有登場的機會，全場是純粹的騎兵機動與弓箭對射，交戰雙方都沒有帶攻城器。此處要說明的是它在同期體系中的位置：西亞與地中海世界自十一世紀末十二世紀初已經用上配重式投石車，1189至1191年第三次十字軍圍攻阿卡期間，攻守雙方都實際架設過配重投石車；此後這門技術隨東方工匠與戰俘向東傳播，1220年代前半已出現在拜占庭的攻城序列與羅斯諸公國的工匠營裡，羅斯城下的工程師多來自匈牙利與德意志的師傅，金帳汗國則在薩萊設廠，1230年代之後在魯良內、弗拉基米爾、科澤爾斯克等圍城戰中都有投石機與弩砲的記載，1240年進攻歐洲時所用的幾座配重投石機也是同一條技術線的產物。真正上了戰場的是下列裝備。蒙古騎兵用角、骨、筋層壓而成的複合反曲弓，張力約六十至七十磅，有效射程可達三百米以上，箭簇多為骨製或鐵製；單刃微彎的蒙古刀；甲胄以皮條編綴的小片札甲為主，外罩絲或麻的內衣，防護重點在肩、胸與馬身，真正的防禦來自騎射與速度。馬是草原小型馬，鞍具高鞍橋高蹬，騎手能在奔馳中放手射擊；進攻前以木樁絆馬、挖陷坑放倒敵軍坐騎，敵散再解絆重整。羅斯方面是傳統的長矛、斧、刀、弓與小型圓盾，公侯親兵另配札甲與頭盔，並有庫曼人的彎刀與複合弓。最關鍵的不是兵器，而是那支由四輪牛車組成、載著戰利品與攻城繩索的輜重車隊，它是全軍最慢的部分，也是蒙古合圍時第一個被摧毀的目標。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet on this card was still a new technology finding its footing in the Eurasian military order of 1223. A counterweight box at the end of a long arm supplied the power to throw a stone over a wall, and it was the main siege instrument against fixed fortifications; on a field battle like the Kalka it had no possible place, for the whole engagement was pure mounted manoeuvre and archery, and neither side brought siege engines. What matters here is where the weapon stood within the contemporary system. The counterweight trebuchet was already in use in West Asia and the Mediterranean from the late eleventh and early twelfth centuries, and it was actually emplaced by both sides during the Third Crusade's siege of Acre between 1189 and 1191. From there the craft spread eastward with eastern craftsmen and prisoners, and by the first half of the 1220s it appeared in the siege trains of Byzantium and in the workshops of the Rus' principalities, whose master builders were often Hungarians or Germans, while the Golden Horde set up foundries at Sarai; the chronicles record catapults and bombards at the sieges of Ryazan, Vladimir and Kozelsk in the 1230s, and the counterweight trebuchets the Mongols used in 1240 came from the same technical line. What actually went into the field at the Kalka was this: Mongol composite recurve bows of horn, bone and sinew, laid up in layers, with a draw weight of roughly sixty to seventy pounds and a useful range beyond three hundred metres, with bone and iron arrowheads; single-edged, slightly curved Mongol sabres; armour made of small plates laced with leather over a silk or hemp coat, protection concentrated on shoulder, chest and horse, the real defence being speed and shooting from the saddle. The horses were small steppe animals, ridden on high-pommel and high-cantled saddles that let the archer loose at full gallop, and before an attack the Mongols hobbled their mounts and dug pits to bring down enemy horses, unhobbling and reforming once the enemy scattered. The Rus' had the traditional spear, axe, sabre, bow and small round shield, with plate and helmet for the princely retinues, plus Cuman sabres and composite bows. The decisive factor was not any of these but the baggage train of four-wheeled ox carts loaded with booty and siege rope: the slowest part of the army, and the first target destroyed once the Mongol encirclement closed.
tactics: 這場戰鬥的勝負，幾乎完全由幾個互相扣連的動作決定。蒙古軍先以哲別的前鋒隊在迦勒迦河下游接觸，隨即丟下部分人馬與牲畜做出慌亂的敗退，把羅斯聯軍引到河的另一側；聯軍內各王公並非同時過河，編年史記載軍隊分三處渡河，有一處甚至是在冰面未化處強行踏破冰層，隊形自此散亂。聯軍在追擊中把輜重車隊留在河這邊，載著戰利品與攻城器材的車隊成了毫無防護的目標。速不台的主力此時佔據河邊高台與廢棄堡壘，居高臨下俯衝而下，正撞在聯軍的中軍與後方；同時前鋒的蒙古騎兵停止退走、折返咬住，兩面合攏，羅斯聯軍被壓在河岸狹窄地帶，前後不能相顧。穆斯特拉夫·雷斯坦諾維奇在包圍合攏前試圖以一次衝鋒扭轉局面，他自渡河起就率約六千人脫離本隊直取蒙古中軍，蒙古騎兵避其鋒芒、待其人馬疲憊才反手合圍，他的突入因此被吸收為戰役的犧牲品。蒙古人隨後有條不紊地打掃戰場，重點不是擴大殺傷，而是逐一辨認並俘虜各王公，俘虜被押往薩萊。這套作戰邏輯是草原式的，不求全殲，只求摧毀對方的指揮與士氣，殘餘兵力自行崩散。羅斯方面的教訓同樣清楚：前鋒與本隊分離、追擊不帶偵察、帶著沉重的車隊進入草原，以及把決定性的一擊押在一次個人衝鋒上。
tacticsEn: The issue was decided almost entirely by a chain of interlocking moves. The Mongols first made contact with Jebe's forward detachment below the Kalka, then dropped some men and cattle in a disorderly retreat, drawing the Rus' coalition to the far bank of the river. The princes did not cross together: the chronicle has the army crossing in three places, one of them by breaking the ice where it had not yet thawed, and the formation came apart in the process. In the pursuit the coalition left its baggage train on the near bank, where the carts of booty and siege gear sat with no protection at all. Subutai's main body meanwhile occupied the heights and the abandoned fort above the river and came down onto the centre and rear of the Rus' army; at the same moment the forward Mongol horsemen stopped retreating, turned back and bit into the flank, so that the trap closed from two sides and the Rus' were crushed into the narrow strip by the water, unable to help either their front or their rear. Before the noose tightened, Mstislav Rostislavich tried to reverse the result with a single charge: from the moment of the crossing he took about six thousand men out of the line and struck at the Mongol centre, and the Mongol horsemen gave way from his charge and closed around him only once his men were spent, so that his breakthrough was swallowed up and spent as the battle's sacrifice. The Mongols then swept the field in an orderly way, their purpose not to extend the killing but to identify and take the princes one by one; the prisoners were sent to Sarai. The logic is steppe logic: not the annihilation of the enemy host but the destruction of its command and morale, leaving the rest to break up on its own. The Rus' lessons are just as clear: vanguard separated from the main body, pursuit without reconnaissance, a heavy train carried into the steppe, and the decisive blow entrusted to one man's charge.
data: 時間：1223年5月31日，按儒略曆計，折合格里曆6月11日；編年史記在5月31日，並說戰鬥發生在聖靈降臨節之後的那個星期日。戰場：迦勒迦河（又寫作卡爾奇克河，是卡爾米烏斯河的支流）下游、亞速海北岸、克里米亞北緣，即前屬基輔公國的突穆塔拉干境內，位置約在今舊克里木一帶；聯軍在追擊中把戰場由河東岸拖到西岸，最後被壓在河邊。兵力：編年史稱羅斯聯軍有八萬人，說大地震動，又說加利奇的穆斯特拉夫自帶六千人作前鋒，這類數字顯然被誇大；現代研究一般把聯軍實數估在一萬五千至兩萬之間，聯軍共有八至九位王公率部參戰，另有數量不明的庫曼人。蒙古方面一般估計兩萬至三萬騎，含阿蘭人與華裔輔助部隊，其中真正投入第一步接觸的是哲別的前鋒數千騎。時間跨度：自上午接觸到日落全面崩潰，約一整日。損失：編年史宣稱殺死六萬至七萬名羅斯人並俘獲數位王公，這個數字同八萬人的說法互相矛盾，只宜視為文體修飾；能確定的結果是聯軍主力被全滅、多位王公被俘，加利奇與基輔兩家的野戰軍本幾乎不復存在。此外可核對的時空數據是：蒙古遠征軍1222年春離開中亞，秋天抵達高加索與格魯吉亞，1222年底至1223年初掃過黑海北岸直至波羅的海沿岸，四個多月後於1223年5月在亞速海邊與羅斯人接觸；羅斯聯軍則自加利奇與沃里尼亞出發，渡過第聶伯河後在草原上連續行軍數週才抵達戰場。
dataEn: Timing: 31 May 1223 in the Julian calendar, equivalent to 11 June in the Gregorian calendar. The chronicle dates the battle to 31 May and states that it was fought on the Sunday after Pentecost. Place: on the lower Kalka river, also written as the Kalchyk, a tributary of the Kalmius, north of the Sea of Azov, on the northern edge of Crimea, in what had been the Tmutarakan land of the Kievan principality, roughly around modern Staryi Krym; the coalition dragged the battlefield from the eastern bank to the western one during the pursuit and was finally pinned against the water. Strength: the chronicle claims eighty thousand Rus', saying that the earth shook, and says Mstislav of Halych led six thousand in the vanguard; such figures are plainly inflated. Modern estimates put the coalition's real strength between fifteen and twenty thousand, with eight to nine princes bringing their own contingents and an unknown number of Cumans. On the Mongol side the usual estimate is twenty to thirty thousand horsemen including Alan and Chinese auxiliaries, of whom only the first few thousand under Jebe made the initial contact. Duration: from the morning contact to the collapse of the Rus' line at sunset, about a full day. Losses: the chronicle claims sixty to seventy thousand Rus' killed and several princes taken, a figure that contradicts the eighty thousand figure and can only be read as literary ornament; what is certain is that the main body of the coalition was destroyed, that several princes were captured, and that the field armies of Halych and Kiev were virtually wiped out. Further verifiable figures of time and space: the Mongol expedition left Central Asia in the spring of 1222, reached the Caucasus and Georgia that autumn, swept the northern shore of the Black Sea in the winter of 1222 to 1223 as far as the Baltic, and met the Rus' on the shore of the Sea of Azov in May 1223, a little over four months later; the Rus' coalition marched out of Halych and Volhynia, crossed the Dnieper and then spent several weeks on the move across the steppe before reaching the field.
cause: 要理解迦勒迦河，必須把鏡頭拉回1219至1221年的花剌子模戰爭。蒙古西征滅掉花剌子模帝國後並未停在裡海東岸：1222年，哲別與速不台率一萬騎越過高加索，掃蕩格魯吉亞、亞美尼亞與亞塞拜疆，又深入波斯哈里發轄下的諸城，繞黑海北岸掃到波羅的海沿岸，歷時一年多才折返；折返途中，這支偏師在亞速海與頓河下游撞上了羅斯南部邊境。碰撞的另一半在羅斯這邊。庫曼與波洛伏齊人長期是羅斯公國在草原上的盟友兼附庸，自1219年起蒙古人把他們向西趕，草原上的舊平衡崩了，羅斯王公反而把騎兵深入草原打劫新到的遊牧部落，搶來的牲畜與財貨堆在家鄉。1221年、1222年，加利奇的穆斯特拉夫與基輔的穆斯特拉夫兩度打到頓河與庫班深處；1223年第三次出動時，他們在草原上聽說有一支大軍正向這邊移動，仍決定順勢打下去，搶劫的誘惑與邊境的危機疊在一起，把聯軍送到蒙古騎兵面前。更深一層的動機是對草原主導權的爭奪：金帳汗國要在黑海北岸建立稅源與外交網，羅斯公國要在草原上保住馬匹來源與牲畜買賣的收益，兩者在亞速海與頓河的交通線上無法並存。雙方其實都談過，蒙古人派來使者要求歸附，羅斯王公也派人去談判，但談判被兵戎相見取代，於是蒙古西征之後第一次大規模正面接觸，就以一整天的會戰收場。
causeEn: To understand the Kalka the camera has to pull back to the Khwarazmian war of 1219 to 1221. After destroying the Khwarazmian empire the Mongols did not stop on the eastern shore of the Caspian. In 1222 Jebe and Subutai rode with about ten thousand men over the Caucasus, swept Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, plundered the cities of the Abbasid caliphate in Persia and rode the northern shore of the Black Sea as far as the Baltic, taking more than a year to come back. On the way back that flying column met the southern frontier of the Rus' around the Sea of Azov and the lower Don. The other half of the collision lay on the Rus' side. The Cumans and Polovtsians had long been allies and dependants of the Rus' princes in the steppe; from 1219 onward the Mongols pushed them westward, the old balance of the steppe collapsed, and the Rus' princes rode deeper into the grass to raid the newly arrived nomads, bringing home livestock and wealth. In 1221 and 1222 Mstislav of Halych and Mstislav of Kiev struck as far as the Don and the Kuban; on their third foray in 1223 they learned on the steppe that a great army was moving in their direction and went on ahead anyway, and the temptation of plunder plus the pressure of a frontier crisis together delivered the coalition to the Mongol horsemen. At a deeper level the quarrel was over who would rule the steppe: the Golden Horde wanted a revenue base and a network of clients on the northern Black Sea, while the Rus' principalities wanted to keep their sources of horses and the returns of the livestock trade, and the two could not coexist on the roads around the Azov and the Don. Both sides did in fact talk: the Mongols sent envoys demanding submission and the Rus' princes sent men to negotiate, but the negotiation was replaced by armed contact, and the first large face-to-face meeting of the Rus' and the Mongols after the western campaign ended with a full day of field battle.
impact: 迦勒迦河是東歐史的轉捩點，影響分成短期與長線兩層。短期是羅斯政治秩序的塌方：基輔公國與切爾尼戈夫公國此後淪為金帳汗國的屬國，須按年進貢，1223年之後羅斯公侯以全羅斯自居的舊政治表述中斷，基輔從此不再是獨立的政治中心；加利奇－沃里尼亞則靠向匈牙利求援，尚能維持半獨立的地位直到1239年蒙古軍拆毀其城邑。長線影響更大。迦勒迦河之後，蒙古人第一次直接接觸到羅斯諸公國與匈牙利王國這些歐洲國家，1236年拔都的西征正是沿著這條被打開的路線推進：羅斯公國成了蒙古西征的前哨與嚮導，1237至1240年蒙古軍在羅斯領土上打開缺口，1239年丹尼爾帶著家眷逃往匈牙利與波蘭，1241年匈牙利王貝拉四世在戰敗後西渡亞得里亞海躲避，1242年蒙古使節出現在格魯吉亞、匈牙利、波蘭與神聖羅馬帝國的宮廷，這是蒙古帝國與拉丁歐洲之間最早的一批直接外交接觸。換句話說，1219年之後蒙古人沿著草原向西推進的終點不是布達佩斯特，而是迦勒迦河這條界線；界線一破，歐洲的歷史便被拉進草原的軌道。軍事史上這場仗的評價也在兩個時代裡擺盪：十九至二十世紀的俄國史學習慣把它講成羅斯封建割據、軍事技術落後的鐵證，近年研究則更願意把它看成兩套同樣成熟的草原與森林混合軍事體系的正面碰撞，羅斯聯軍有重騎兵、有庫曼弓手、有攻城技術，缺的是把這三者合成一個體系的戰術整合，蒙古人則用一次佯退、一次側翼包抄、一次對後勤車隊的精確打擊，把對手的全部優勢變成負擔。歸根到底，這場戰爭的勝負是速度與協同贏了規模與裝備。
impactEn: The Kalka is a turning point in the history of Eastern Europe, and its effects divide into a short and a long layer. In the short term the political order of the Rus' collapsed: Kiev and Chernigov became dependencies of the Golden Horde paying annual tribute, and the old political formula in which the Rus' princes claimed to rule all Rus' came to an end after 1223, with Kiev ceasing to be an independent centre of power; Galicia-Volhynia, which turned to Hungary for support, held out as a half-independent polity until the Mongols destroyed its city in 1239. The long-term effect is larger still. After the Kalka the Mongols came into direct contact for the first time with such European states as the Rus' principalities and the kingdom of Hungary, and Batu's western campaign of 1236 was driven along exactly that opened route: the Rus' principalities became forward posts and guides for the Mongol advance into Europe, the Mongol armies of 1237 to 1240 tore openings in Rus' territory, Daniel fled with his household to Hungary and Poland in 1239, King Béla IV of Hungary crossed to the Adriatic coast to escape after his defeat in 1241, and Mongol envoys appeared at the courts of Georgia, Hungary, Poland and the Holy Roman Empire in 1242, the earliest direct diplomatic contacts between the Mongol empire and Latin Europe. In other words, the western end point of the Mongol drive along the steppe after 1219 was not Budapest but the line of the Kalka; once that line broke, the history of Europe was pulled onto the steppe's track. The military verdict on the battle has swung between two eras as well: nineteenth and twentieth century Russian historiography used it as proof of Rus' feudal fragmentation and military backwardness, while recent work is readier to treat it as a collision between two equally mature steppe-forest military systems. The Rus' coalition had heavy cavalry, Cuman archers and siegecraft; what it lacked was the tactical integration that fused the three. The Mongols, with a feigned retreat, a flank encirclement and a precise blow against the baggage train, turned every one of the opponent's advantages into a burden. In the end, speed and coordination beat scale and equipment.
result: 結果沒有爭議，蒙古軍全勝，羅斯聯軍被徹底摧毀。聯軍渡河追擊之後被壓在迦勒迦河西岸的狹窄地帶，中軍與後方同時被打斷，編年史說到入夜時全軍已無成建制。穆斯特拉夫·雷斯坦諾維奇、基輔王穆斯特拉夫·米斯提斯拉維奇、切爾尼戈夫王羅曼·伊戈列維奇等人被俘，後來押往薩萊，其中基輔王與羅曼相繼死於囚禁，羅斯公國全體公侯的招牌就此斷在迦勒迦河。僥倖者數目極少，羅曼的兒子奧列格與加利奇的丹尼爾被俘後得到蒙古人的寬待，得以重返自己的土地；丹尼爾其後在1239至1240年蒙古軍拆毀加利奇時再次西逃，輾轉匈牙利與波蘭，並靠母系與婚姻關係為羅斯與西方之間留下一條極細的通道。羅斯方面的實力損失是結構性的：大批王公與軍隊消失在迦勒迦河下游，能帶回鄉的只有少數倖存者，草原方向的主動權從此歸於金帳汗國，羅斯各公國的野戰軍隊需要重新組建，而重建時已沒有挑戰草原的選項。若從技術史看，這場戰爭還有一層反諷：它決定了東歐命運的那一天，卡面上這件配重投石車恰恰不在場。這說明十二世紀的軍事勝負已不再單靠攻城器械定奪，當野戰機動、遠程弓砲與後勤速度決定了會戰勝負，工程兵器便退到圍城階段才真正發揮威力。金帳汗國後來在薩萊設廠、鍛造攻城器械，把配重投石車帶進歐洲戰場的那一幕，正是迦勒迦河之後才發生的事。
resultEn: There is no dispute about the result: the Mongols won outright and the Rus' coalition was destroyed. After the crossing and the pursuit the coalition was pinned in the narrow strip on the western bank of the Kalka, with the centre and the rear cut apart at the same time, and the chronicle says that by nightfall the army no longer existed as an organised force. Mstislav Rostislavich, Mstislav Mstislavich of Kiev, Roman Igorevich of Chernigov and others were taken prisoner and later sent to Sarai, where the prince of Kiev and Roman died in captivity; the claim of the Rus' princes to be lords of all Rus' was broken on the Kalka. The number of survivors was tiny. Oleg, son of Roman, and Daniel of Halych were treated leniently by the Mongols after their capture and were allowed to return to their own lands; Daniel fled west once more when the Mongols destroyed Halych in 1239 to 1240, moving through Hungary and Poland, and his maternal and marital connections left a very thin channel between the Rus' and the West. The Rus' losses were structural: princes and armies vanished on the lower Kalka, only a few survivors brought the news home, and the initiative on the steppe passed permanently to the Golden Horde. The field armies of the Rus' principalities had to be rebuilt, and by the time they were rebuilt there was no longer any option of challenging the steppe. From the point of view of technical history there is an irony in the outcome: on the day that settled the fate of Eastern Europe, the counterweight trebuchet on the card was conspicuously absent. It shows that by the thirteenth century the outcome of war was no longer decided by siege engines alone; once field manoeuvre, missile power and the speed of logistics decided pitched battles, engineering weapons only came fully into their own in the siege. That the Golden Horde later set up foundries at Sarai, cast siege engines and carried the counterweight trebuchet into the European theatre was a consequence of what happened after the Kalka.
